questions.question_text: How can you create a new user in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: The Azure portal provides a user-friendly UI to create users; PowerShell and Graph API are alternative methods but the most common approach is the portal.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet creates a new user in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: New-AzureADUser creates a new user object; the other cmdlets are used for different operations such as adding an existing user or modifying properties.

questions.question_text: When managing user properties, which attribute determines whether a user can sign in to Azure AD?
questions.explanation: The AccountEnabled property indicates if the account is active; a disabled account cannot sign in, even if other properties are correct.

questions.question_text: How do you assign a license to an existing user in Microsoft Entra ID?

options.label: A
options.text: In the Azure portal, go to the user and select Licenses

options.label: B
options.text: Use the Azure AD Connect sync tool

options.label: C
options.text: Edit the user's profile in Azure AD B2C

options.label: D
options.text: Run a PowerShell script to modify the user's email

questions.explanation: Licenses are managed per user via the Azure portal's Licenses blade; you select the user and assign the required license there.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of managing external users (B2B) in Microsoft Entra ID?

options.label: A
options.text: To allow users from other organizations to access resources using their own credentials

options.label: B
options.text: To create internal guest accounts only

options.label: C
options.text: To restrict sign-in times for all users

options.label: D
options.text: To assign administrator roles to external users

questions.explanation: B2B collaboration lets external users sign in with their own credentials while being managed in your tenant, enabling secure cross‑organization access.

questions.question_text: Which feature enables self-service password reset for users in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) allows users to reset their passwords without contacting an administrator.

questions.question_text: When creating a group, which type supports dynamic membership based on rule definitions?
questions.explanation: Dynamic groups are created using membership rules; they can be security‑based or Microsoft 365‑based, but the type is called a Dynamic group.

questions.question_text: Which API is used to manage external user invitations (B2B) in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Graph provides endpoints for inviting, confirming, and managing B2B external users.

questions.question_text: Before deleting a user, what step ensures the user's license remains available for another user?

options.label: A
options.text: Reassign the license to another user

options.label: B
options.text: Delete the license from the user

questions.explanation: Reassigning the license frees it for another user while preserving the license assignment in the tenant.

questions.question_text: Which setting enables password reset without admin assistance for users?
questions.explanation: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) lets users reset their passwords independently of an administrator.
